CHARACTER: LU XUN (陆寻), the 22-year-old human male protagonist and EV-04 AEGIS pilot. Proposed casting: East Asian young man, lean athletic build, short slightly untidy black hair, warm dark eyes, youthful face with restrained determination and visible fatigue. He was seven when his mother Lin Yao promised to return in three years; fifteen years later he searches for her while learning to rescue others. A believable young person carrying responsibility, not an older hardened commando. Wear a tailored functional ivory-and-graphite pilot pressure suit with cobalt reinforced panels, small muted crimson shoulder accent, flexible ribbed joints, survival harness, reinforced gloves and practical boots. His FACE is uncovered, carry a compact ivory pilot helmet tucked under one arm and a small worn personal recorder secured near chest. No handheld firearm. Full-body pose quiet and alert beside a spacecraft cockpit boarding gantry, subtle huge blurred cobalt/ivory mech leg in distant background to establish scale but not compete. Right portrait shows thoughtful young face looking slightly beyond camera, a touch of grief and resolve. Controlled realistic hangar lighting.
